activities.activity_description: Implement all required individual orderer configuration update functions: SetMaxMessageCount, SetAbsoluteMaxBytes, SetPreferredMaxBytes, SetBatchTimeout, SetMaxChannels, SetConsensusType, SetConsensusState, add functions for modifying individual EtcdRaftMetadata values/options, ensure all functions persist existing values for unmodified fields, update examples to demonstrate both the new individual update functions and the existing Get/SetConfiguration flow.

Implement all required individual MSP configuration update functions for OrdererOrgGroup, ApplicationOrgGroup, and ConsortiumOrgGroup: AddRootCert, RemoveRootCert, AddIntermediateCert, RemoveIntermediateCert, AddAdminCert, RemoveAdminCert, AddCRL, RemoveCRL, AddOUIdentifier, RemoveOUIdentifier, SetCryptoConfig, AddTLSRootCert, RemoveTLSRootCert, AddTLSIntermediateCert, RemoveTLSIntermediateCert, SetClientOUIdentifier, SetPeerOUIdentifier, SetAdminOUIdentifier, SetOrdererOUIdentifier, EnableNodeOUs, DisableNodeOUs, add required certificate validation logic, update examples to demonstrate both the new individual update functions and the existing Get/SetMSP flow for all org group types.

Write unit tests for all new API functions and CLI tool components covering edge cases and error conditions, write integration tests for end-to-end flows (e.g., consortium addition, orderer address removal, bulk CLI operations against a test Fabric network), fix any bugs identified during testing.

Update the fabric-config library README and API documentation to include all new functions and usage guidelines, verify all code examples are correct and runnable, add documentation for the new bulk CLI tool including usage instructions, input format specifications, and the example command specified in user story U6.
